runners_data.name: Twilight Calls

runners_data.name: Cressida Wildes
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with good course form including a win here, visor applied and represents in-form connections

runners_data.name: Lipsink
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning from long break with strong course record, key to pace scenario but 218 days off track

runners_data.name: Charlie Mason
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent current form with course winner on board, should be thereabouts throughout

runners_data.name: Silver Wraith
runners_data.note: Prominent type wearing tongue-tie with solid recent form, Emma Lavelle's horses running well currently

runners_data.name: Good Earth
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who won last time out and handles the course, needs tactical race but Connor Planas riding well

runners_data.name: Sandscreendeliverd
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good recent course form, Pat Dobbs booking suggests connections confident

runners_data.name: Rage Of Thunder
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose form has declined recently, needs everything to drop right from poor draw

runners_data.name: Over Spiced
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong course record and Oisin Murphy booking, prominent tongue-tie suggests tactical switch

races.paceDynamic: Lipsink is the only confirmed front runner and will take them along at a manageable clip without pressure, given the lack of early pace in this field. Charlie Mason and Silver Wraith will track prominently but neither is aggressive enough to force the issue early. The majority of this field wants to be held up, including Twilight Calls, Tan Rapido, Cressida Wildes, Good Earth, Sandscreendeliverd, Rage Of Thunder and Over Spiced. This creates a tactical race where the prominent runners get first run but the hold-up horses have the numbers advantage in a finish where positioning and pace judgement become crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lipsink Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Lipsink establishes an uncontested lead and dictates terms
scenarios.body: The veteran gets an easy time in front and proves hard to peg back, with the prominent runners getting first crack but lacking the pace to reel him in. This rewards horses that can track the pace without being too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Swarms
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady enough for the hold-up horses to unleash collectively
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses gets the perfect tactical setup with a true-run race, allowing the best of them to time their challenge perfectly. Superior class and finishing kick decides between them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes
scenarios.trigger: If Charlie Mason or Silver Wraith force the pace earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The race becomes more genuinely run when the prominent horses push forward, stretching the field and putting the hold-up horses under more pressure. Those with tactical pace benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make it a test and it becomes a sprint from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely and it becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs, favoring those with the best finishing kick regardless of position. The fastest horse on the day wins.

watchPoints.text: Lipsink could steal this if allowed an easy lead given the lack of early pace, but the 218-day layoff is a major concern
Charlie Mason's recent course win and current form make him dangerous if getting first run on the leaders
Over Spiced has Oisin Murphy aboard and excellent course form, could be overpriced given the jockey booking
Silver Wraith's tongue-tie application suggests connections expect improvement from this consistent type
The large number of hold-up horses could create traffic problems in the straight, watch for clear runs

runners_data.name: Betties Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent racer dropping back from 6f with excellent recent form, though similar going record shows limited experience.

runners_data.name: Cayman Tai
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with a 5lb claimer aboard, needs the pace to develop to unleash his trademark late kick.

runners_data.name: Carbine Harvester
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer from powerful Haggas stable, though recent 6f form suggests 5f might be too sharp.

runners_data.name: Kiss And Run
runners_data.note: Strong closer who needs pace help over this minimum trip, 25 days since last run adds slight fitness question.

runners_data.name: Lequinto
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent racer with course experience and solid recent form, though 9-year-old legs might be slowing.

runners_data.name: Fantasy Master

races.paceDynamic: Em Four and Nogo's Dream will set a reasonable gallop from the front, with Fantasy Master and Lequinto likely to track them prominently. The lack of multiple speed horses means the pace should be manageable rather than cut-throat. Hold-up horses like Cayman Tai, Carbine Harvester and Kiss And Run will rely on the prominent group maintaining enough tempo to set up their finishing kicks. This moderate pace scenario favours the prominent racers who can position handy and have enough left to see off the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and honest without becoming overly strong
scenarios.body: The handy horses can control their effort and have enough left to repel late challengers on this sharp 5f course. Those tracking the leaders avoid traffic problems and can quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group go marginally too fast in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The pace becomes enough to set up a closer without being so strong that it favours the leaders completely. Cayman Tai and Kiss And Run get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Em Four gets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes very pedestrian
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and have plenty left for the finish. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on such a short course with minimal pace assistance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the final furlong creating a blanket finish
scenarios.body: The even pace means several horses arrive with chances and it becomes a pure speed duel to the line. Course experience and jockey strength become crucial factors.

watchPoints.text: Em Four could steal this if getting a soft lead as the main pace angle, monitor early fractions closely.
Cayman Tai's 5lb claimer Seamus Cronin needs to judge the pace perfectly to deliver his mount's kick at the right moment.
Betties Bay's recent 6f wins suggest fitness is sharp, watch if she can transfer that form back to this minimum trip.
The hold-up horses Kiss And Run and Carbine Harvester need the prominent group to go fast enough to set up their closes.
Nogo's Dream's consistent prominent style and proven form at the trip makes her the pace-tracking banker.

races.paceDynamic: Greek Order stands out as the sole natural front runner in this large field of 17, likely to dictate terms from the front with Boyfriend, Sweet Reward, and Alcarath pressing from prominent positions. With limited early pace pressure, Greek Order can set a steady gallop that may not test the stamina reserves until the final 2-3 furlongs. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses including Al Aali, Dangerman, and Samuel Colt who will need the pace to collapse in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the lone front runner who can control the tempo without interference.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Order gets an uncontested lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: Greek Order faces minimal pressure through the middle stages and has enough left to resist late challengers, while prominent horses like Sweet Reward and Alcarath benefit from the strong tempo. The hold-up brigade arrives too late against the solid pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong through mid-race pressure
scenarios.body: Sweet Reward or Boyfriend capitalize on their forward positions to strike approaching the final furlong as Greek Order weakens from honest pace. The experienced campaigners with tactical speed prove superior to pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early leaders go too fast due to competitive jockeys
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for Dangerman, Al Aali and other hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Class tells when the pace falls apart completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Setup
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow with no genuine pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 3f pole where Whitcombe Rockstar's recent all-weather form and Baltic Voyage's staying power become assets. Late pace and finishing kick matter more than position.

watchPoints.text: Greek Order getting an easy uncontested lead through the first half-mile will make him very hard to peg back
Sweet Reward's low weight and hat-trick bid could see aggressive tactics from apprentice Olivia Tubb
Dangerman and Al Aali need to be handy enough turning for home if the pace becomes truly searching
Boyfriend and Alcarath pressing Greek Order too early could compromise their own finishing kicks
The large field of 17 may cause traffic problems for hold-up horses in the straight

races.paceDynamic: Bridge Of Eagles will lead from the start with no genuine early pace pressure in this 13-runner field. Akho Mezzna and Brighton View may settle prominently but both can track rather than challenge early. The lack of natural front-runners means Bridge Of Eagles can dictate a comfortable tempo through the first half-mile before the field bunches turning for home. This moderate gallop heavily favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks, with Devil's Peak, Qarreeb, Chapter, Edwin Hubble and Dryburgh all possessing the tactical speed to capitalise on what should be a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Soft Lead Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Bridge Of Eagles sets uncontested fractions and the field arrives in one piece
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow early allowingClosers to wind up from the back with devastating effect. Hold-up horses with tactical speed will have every chance to showcase their finishing kick over this stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Press On
scenarios.trigger: If Akho Mezzna and Brighton View push forward to pressure Bridge Of Eagles
scenarios.body: A more honest gallop develops which still favours closers but gives the pace-setters a fighting chance if they can sustain their effort. The increased tempo will set up those with proven finishing speed over middle distances.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple jockeys decide to sit and wait behind a dawdling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the three-furlong pole with traffic problems likely in the straight. Patient hold-up horses positioned widest will have the clearest run when the serious racing begins late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Bridge Bolts Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Bridge Of Eagles kicks clear turning for home and sustains the effort
scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalises on his uncontested lead to build an unassailable advantage. Only horses with proven stamina reserves and tactical pace will close the deficit in the final two furlongs.

watchPoints.text: Bridge Of Eagles could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions without any early pace pressure from the prominent runners
Devil's Peak and Chapter represent dangerous hold-up threats if the pace collapses with both possessing proven finishing kicks over this trip
Dryburgh has been running well in similar company and could benefit from the likely tactical nature with her hold-up style perfectly suited
Traffic problems are likely in the straight if multiple hold-up horses are caught behind the slow early pace set by Bridge Of Eagles
Akho Mezzna needs to justify the headgear change and Murphy booking by showing more determination in the closing stages than recently

races.paceDynamic: Starryfield provides the only reliable pace angle with his prominent style, likely joined early by Southern Warrior and Lion Of Mali who both show pace tendencies. This creates a moderate but sustainable gallop rather than fierce tempo, as the majority field comprises hold-up performers who will settle off the pace. With so many hold-up horses (Euphonia, Lohoobb, Kilkenny Warrior, Kimbara, Ecclefechan, Robert Anstruther, Galba) tracking behind, the race sets up perfectly for closers who can produce their best work in the final two furlongs when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Starryfield sets steady fractions without serious pressure early
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up performers get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Quality closers like Euphonia and Lohoobb can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes very slow and pedestrian
scenarios.body: The prominent runners maintain enough energy reserves to resist late challengers on a track that can favor those who avoid trouble. Starryfield and Lion Of Mali benefit from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Starryfield entering the home turn
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly from the 3f marker, suiting horses with tactical speed rather than pure hold-up types. This creates opportunities for those with versatile running styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Weakens Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Southern Warrior and Lion Of Mali pressure Starryfield from the outset
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes genuinely strong, setting up the race for the most patient hold-up horses with the strongest finishing kicks. Late runners benefit from the collapse ahead.

watchPoints.text: Starryfield must handle the early responsibility as the lone pace-setter, any reluctance to lead would collapse the race tempo
Lion Of Mali's front-running tendencies could create an unwanted pace duel if he challenges Starryfield too early in the contest
Kilkenny Warrior sports first-time pacifiers after poor recent runs, headgear change suggests connections expect improved behavior
Multiple hold-up horses may get caught behind a wall of horses in the straight if the pace is too slow early on
Southern Warrior carries 5lb apprentice claiming weight which provides significant advantage in this competitive handicap field

races.paceDynamic: King Of Berkshire will set a controlled gallop from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field. Heroics may track prominently but the lack of genuine speed means a steady tempo through the early stages. The pace will build gradually from halfway as the hold-up trio of Wardlaw, Red Rifle and Fuzeyya begin their moves from the rear. This sustainable early pace strongly favours the front-runners and prominent racers who can dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: King Of Berkshire Controls
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Berkshire gets his preferred uncontested lead and steady early fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions before quickening decisively in the straight when his class advantage tells. The hold-up horses face too much ground to make up against a horse of his calibre controlling the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Heroics Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Heroics races more aggressively to pressure King Of Berkshire early and sustain his challenge
scenarios.body: A stronger early gallop could expose King Of Berkshire's stamina at this longer trip and allow Heroics to capitalize on his recent good form. The faster pace also brings the closers more into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Red Rifle Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely sedate and Red Rifle gets the perfect hold-up trip
scenarios.body: His recent Goodwood win shows he has the ability to pick up strongly when getting the right racing conditions. A slow pace maximizes his finishing kick against this grade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wardlaw Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Mark Prescott has found significant improvement and Wardlaw gets ideal pace conditions
scenarios.body: His trainer's 15% strike rate and the blinkers could spark better performance in a slowly-run race. However, he faces a significant class deficit against the main contenders.

watchPoints.text: King Of Berkshire must be watched for how aggressively Oisin Murphy chooses to use his early speed advantage
Monitor if Heroics decides to press King Of Berkshire early rather than settling in behind
Red Rifle's position turning for home will indicate if he has the tactical speed to be competitive
The overall early pace will determine whether this becomes a sprint finish or genuine test of stamina
Luke Morris on Wardlaw may need to commit earlier than ideal if the pace becomes too strong
